definition: Filamin-A-interacting protein 1 (FILIP1) is a structural protein involved in neuronal and muscle function and integrity that interacts with filamins FLNa and FLNc; biallelic loss-of-function or pathogenic variants in the FILIP1 gene cause an autosomal recessive syndrome characterized by congenital neuromuscular manifestations, myopathy, dysmorphic features, and neurological defects (OMIM #620775).

source.title: Bi-allelic variants of FILIP1 cause congenital myopathy, dysmorphism and neurological defects
source.quote: Filamin-A-interacting protein 1 (FILIP1) is a structural protein that is involved in neuronal and muscle function and integrity and interacts with FLNa and FLNc.
